GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311.1 (25 Aug 46) CCS
(SCAPIN-1155)
APO 500
25 August 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Repatriation Mail Service between Japan and Manchuria.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum SCAPIN-202, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, File AG 311.7 (28 Oct 45) CIS, subject “Establishment of Limited Mail System for Japanese Awaiting Repatriation” and to CLO 3177 (CC) addressed to General Headquarters of the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, requesting authorization to exchange repatriation mail through the port of Hulutao, Manchuria, for Japanese nationals in the Mukden area.
2. The Chinese authorities have advised they can handle the distribution of the mail. Subject to all limitations imposed by the Memorandum cited, repatriation mails for Manchuria may now be exchanged through the part of Hulutao.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
